name: Jesus Sacrifice
overview: The Scriptures reveal that Jesus' sacrifice is the ultimate demonstration of God's love, given so that believers may receive eternal life (John 3:16) and access to the Father through Him alone (John 14:6). Though fully divine (Philippians 2:6), Christ willingly offered Himself as an atoning sacrifice for sinners (Romans 5:8; Ephesians 5:2), fulfilling the prophetic revelation of God's redemptive plan (Isaiah 53:1). This sacrifice calls believers to live in love, reflecting the self-giving nature of Christ.
